title: About Me
text: Hello, I am Vanessa Perez. I am current a Graduate Student at UIC in process of obtaining my Master of Science in Civic Analytics. Previously, I attended University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and obtained my B.S in Kinesiology.

title: PastProject
text: Here I have Included a PDF of a project I have worked on in the past. This is my project for my PA 402 course here at UIC. For this project, I looked into how socioeconomic status and school type shapes average SAT scores. I was able to manipulate and clean data from a chicago data portal in order to create the maps and tables shown using R.
